newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy state railway to launch two trln lire bond.
newsitem.headline: Italy state railway to launch two trln lire bond.

text.p: Italy's state railways said on Friday they are to launch a two trillion lire variable interest rate domestic bond, jointly led by Banca di Roma and Credito Italiano.
The 12-year bond would carry a coupon with a 0.10 percent spread over Rome interbank offered rates (Ribor).
The statement added the spread would be calculated over the 6-month Ribor rate
The bond, to be issued at par, will have an issue date of December 3 1996 and reach maturity on December 3, 2008.
The bond is callable at par from the start of the third year from the issue date and at each subsequent coupon payment date.
The public offer will run from November 20-22 unless it is fully subscribed before the closing date.
A one trillion lire state railways eight-year bond falls due on November 18.
The statement said the latest offering's 0.10 percent spread over the six-month Ribor rate, compared with a 0.20 percent spread over three-month Ribor in a five-year issue at the end of March.
